paper.title: Accurate and Robust Stellar Rotation Periods catalog for 82771 Kepler stars using deep learning

result.summary: 本文提出了 LightPred，一个用于从 Kepler 光变曲线中提取恒星自转周期的深度学习模型，采用 LSTM 与 Transformer 双分支架构，并结合自监督对比预训练与基于模拟光变曲线的监督训练 [abstract][S1.p3]。在模拟数据上，LightPred 在准确率和平均误差方面优于自相关函数（ACF）等经典方法 [abstract][S5.SS1.p2]。作者将模型应用于 Kepler 数据，生成了迄今最大的自转周期目录，包含 82771 条可靠预测 [abstract][S5.SS3.p2]。作者指出，这些发现展示了深度学习从光变曲线中提取基本恒星参数的潜力 [abstract][S6.p5]。

research_question.text: 论文旨在利用深度学习从 Kepler 光变曲线中测量恒星自转周期，以应对经典方法在大数据集上耗时、难以处理复杂光变曲线且无法提供不确定性估计的问题 [S1.p2][S1.SS1.p1]。作者指出，恒星自转周期的研究对理解恒星演化、活动周以及系外行星探测日益重要，而空间测光任务提供了大量高精度长时标光变曲线 [S1.p1]。

evidence.quote: The study of stellar rotation periods has become increasingly important in our understanding of stellar evolution, activity cycles, and exoplanet detection.
Classical methods for measuring rotation periods, such as Lomb-Scargle periodograms and autocorrelation functions, have been successful
but can be time-consuming and challenging to apply to large datasets.
One shortcoming of classical methods is their inability to provide uncertainty estimates for predictions, which are essential for evaluating the reliability of the results.

method.text: LightPred 采用双分支架构，结合 LSTM 与 Transformer 组件以捕捉光变曲线中的时间与全局特征 [abstract][S6.p1]。模型先使用 Kepler 样本进行自监督对比预训练（SSL），再以模拟光变曲线进行监督训练（SBSL）[S4.SS2.p1]。模拟数据由基于简化黑子模型的 Butterpy 生成 [S2.SS1.p1]。模型输出自转周期、倾角以及两者的置信度分数 [S3.SS1.p4]。

evidence.quote: The model utilizes a dual-branch architecture combining Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) and Transformer components to capture temporal and global data features.
By leveraging a dual-branch architecture that incorporates LSTM and Transformer components, LightPred excels at capturing both temporal dependencies and global patterns within light curves.
First, we trained the model, without the prediction head, in a self-supervised fashion, with Kepler samples.
Next, we used the weights from the SSL Step as an initialization for supervised training with the mock dataset.
To create a dataset for supervised training we used simulated light curves using Butterpy, a python package described in.
The output of the model is four numbers: rotation period, inclination, period confidence score, and inclination confidence score.

experiments.text: 作者在 50000 条、时长 1000 天的模拟光变曲线上训练模型，并按 81%/9%/10% 划分训练、验证与测试集 [S4.SS2.p1]。在模拟数据上，作者将 LightPred 与 ACF、GPS 方法以及 Tel-Aviv 团队的结果进行比较 [S5.SS1.p2]。在 Kepler 数据上，作者使用 130868 条满足 8 个连续季度的样本进行 SSL 训练与推断，并最终得到 82771 条可靠预测 [S5.SS2.p1][S5.SS3.p2]。

evidence.quote: This was done on a dataset of 50000 simulated samples of 1000 days that were generated as explained in II.1 and II.2.
We then split the dataset into training ( $81\%$), validation ( $9\%$), and test sets ( $10\%$).
We compare our results to the results reported by the Tel-Aviv team in.
we also implemented ACF and GPS methods and tested them on our test set.
This left us with 130868 which serves both for the SSL step and the inference.
This procedure left us with 82771 reliable predictions.

findings.text: 在模拟数据上，LightPred 在噪声与无噪声样本上均优于 Tel-Aviv 团队的结果，且比 ACF 和 GPS 更稳健；ACF 和 GPS 仅能有效预测约 85% 的数据集，而 LightPred 能预测全部样本 [S5.SS1.p2]。在有效预测子集上，ACF 的 acc10p 和 acc20p 与 LightPred 相当，但 LightPred 的平均误差显著更低 [S5.SS1.p2]。在 Kepler 数据上，模型学到的置信度与物理性质相关，且与三个最大目录的比较显示，不一致的点主要集中在大约半周期线和参考周期接近零的区域 [S5.SS2.SSS2.p4]。作者还确认了轨道周期短于 10 天的食双星中的潮汐同步现象 [abstract]。

evidence.quote: It can be seen that our results are better for both noisy and noiseless samples.
It can be seen that both ACF and GPS predicted effectively $\sim 85\%$ of the dataset while our model predicted the entire dataset.
For a subset of valid predictions, we see that the performance of ACF is comparable to our model in terms of acc10p and acc20p but our model shows significantly lower average error.
It can be seen that in general, more confident samples have better agreement.
the first region is around the half period line Which suggests a ’double period mistake’.
Additionally, we confirm tidal synchronization in eclipsing binaries with orbital periods shorter than 10 days.

limitations.text: 作者指出，模拟所基于的黑子模型存在倾角与黑子位置之间的内在简并，且模型依赖先验，黑子分布对结果影响很大 [S2.SS1.p1]。作者承认，打乱季度（90 天）的增强可能移除相位信息并潜在地妨碍长周期探测 [S2.SS3.p1]。此外，拥挤和双星可能使观测光变曲线不代表单一目标，从而对预测产生偏差 [S5.SS2.SSS4.p1]。作者还指出，未来需要改进模拟中的黑子模型，特别是考虑快速自转年轻恒星的行为 [S6.p5]。

evidence.quote: The suggested model implies an inherent degeneracy between inclination and spot location.
This implies that the model is prior-depended: the distribution of spots in the model has a large effect on the results.
We acknowledge that shuffling quarters (90 Days) might remove phase information and potentially hinder the detection of long periods.
It is possible that the observed light curve does not represent a single object but multiple objects.
including the development of improved spot models for simulation data, particularly to account for the behavior of fast-rotating young stars.
